title: Implement the business-logic code behind the already-wired "Assign Agent" button
description:
On the form "Manage Ticket Assignment" (support360_ticket_assignment), the "Assign Agent" button currently does nothing when clicked. Implement its action now.

On click:
1. Read Category Name (e.g. HARDWARE) from the current record.
2. Look in the Agent Master table for the first agent where Preference equals Category Name (case-insensitive), Status = Active and Availability = Available, ordered by Agent ID.
3. If found, set on the current record:
   A. Assigned Agent = that agent's Agent ID
   B. Assigned Agent Name = that agent's Agent Name
   C. Status = "Assigned"
   Then save the record and refresh the form so the new values show immediately.
4. If no agent is found, show the message "No available agent found for <Category Name>" and change nothing.
5. If Status is already "Assigned", show "Ticket already assigned" and do nothing.

Do not delete or rename any field. Only add or fix the logic of the Assign Agent button. After building, tell me exactly which fields and which table the button reads and writes.

phases.title: Master & lookup data

phases.rationale: Ticket creation, queue handling and auto-matched agent assignment depend on the category, priority and agent masters.

phases.title: Visuals
phases.rationale: Employee ticket charts need ticket data with priority and status already in place.

phases.title: Dashboards
phases.rationale: The agent and admin dashboards bring together the ticket transactions and visuals built in earlier phases.
